edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the debit address for balances in transfer.
msg.sender indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
msg.sender is used as spender key in allowed[from][msg.sender] and in newun assignment.
msg.sender is used as allowance owner and as the from argument of receiveApproval.
clearCNDAO authorization depends on msg.sender via the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender is forwarded into the external receiveApproval call.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal newOwner.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to owner.
transfernewun is owner-only, authorization derived from msg.sender.
to parameter is compared with newun and used as credit address in transfer.
tokens parameter is subtracted from and added to balances in transfer.
spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
from parameter is debited and used as allowance owner key in transferFrom.
to parameter is credited and compared with newun in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is subtracted from balances and allowance in transferFrom.
spender parameter receives the allowance and is the target contract of the external call.
_newun parameter is written into the newun state variable.
_newOwner parameter is written into the newOwner state variable.
transfer writes updated balances for msg.sender and to.
transferFrom writes updated balances for from and to.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
newun is read in the require check inside transfer.
transfer reads newun only; no write occurs, relation expressed as state read.
transferFrom conditionally writes newun when from is not zero and newun is zero.
transferOwnership writes the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
acceptOwnership writes owner with the accepted newOwner value.
clearCNDAO execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier reading owner.
transfernewun execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier reading owner.
transferOwnership execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier reading owner.
approveAndCall performs an external call to receiveApproval on a caller-supplied contract address.
The external receiveApproval call can re-enter approveAndCall or other token functions.
clearCNDAO sends address(this).balance to the recipient.
Local _owner holds msg.sender and is the target of the ether transfer.
transfer relies on SafeMath.sub/add guards for balance arithmetic.
transferFrom relies on SafeMath.sub/add guards for balance and allowance arithmetic.
clearCNDAO assigns msg.sender to the local payable _owner, whose authority is the onlyOwner check.
